description:
Campaign evidence validity is currently keyed to the harness binary hash and source revision, so documentation-only edits threaten committed evidence; converge on @/inv/behavioral-evidence-validity by pinning a behavioral identity that documentation changes cannot move.

## Background

Registered invariants @/inv/behavioral-evidence-validity and @/inv/runtime-observed-provenance post-date the runner manifest (verify_manifest pins binary SHA-256; comment edits shift debug info and thus the binary). A docs-only citation repair after run 20260814T230032Z-2085453 had to be escalated because reviewers treat evidence from a non-final tool revision as invalid.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The runner manifest records a behavioral identity for each measurement tool — a hash over the behavior-relevant input set (or a reproducible build with documentation-invariant output) — and run provenance records it beside the binary hash.
- [hard] REQ-02: A documentation-only change to tool source demonstrably leaves the behavioral identity unchanged, with a test or recorded check asserting it.
- [hard] REQ-03: An audit confirms emitted preambles satisfy @/inv/runtime-observed-provenance (runtime-observed facts, own protocol constants, identity-based citations only), with any violation fixed or filed.

## Notes

Enforces @/inv/behavioral-evidence-validity and @/inv/runtime-observed-provenance.
title: Behavioral evidence identity for campaign tooling
